drivetrain.notes: The official BMW 03/2025 G61 technical-specification PDF lists the 520i Touring as rear-wheel drive.

transmission.notes: The official BMW 03/2025 G61 technical-specification PDF lists an eight-speed Steptronic transmission for the 520i Touring; the repo maps it to the ZF8HP family code, which the sheet does not print.

default.notes: The official BMW 03/2025 G61 technical-specification PDF lists 225/55 R18 102Y XL as the standard tyre for the 520i Touring.

verification_notes.note: Touring body added from the official BMW 03/2025 G61 sheet: 520i Touring, rear-wheel drive, eight-speed Steptronic, eighth gear 0.640, rear axle ratio 3.077 and standard 225/55 R18 tyres, matching the G60 520i Sedan. BMW added the 520i Touring to the line-up from 11/2024.
